title: Dhol Baaje 2026
description: Experience the Magic of DHOL BAAJE 2026
long_description:
Experience the Magic of DHOL BAAJE 2026
Get ready to immerse yourself in the enchanting vibrancy of the DHOL BAAJE 2026. Mark your calendars for the 10th day of October, 2026. This evening of immense joy and celebration will be a blend of English, Hindi, Gujarati, and Marathi cultures, with a special focus on Navratri and Dandiya dances, soulful singing, and Bollywood entertainment. This fusion of traditions will create an unforgettable aura of music, dance, and joy.
Introducing Our Talented Performers
Although we do not have specific artists lined up for this event, our performers are versatile and experienced artists who are able to seamlessly blend various cultural elements into a cohesive performance. With a deep understanding of English, Hindi, Gujarati, and Marathi cultures, these performers will transport you to a world of rhythm, melody, and enchantment.
Join Us at the Spectacular David L. Lawrence Convention Center
We welcome you to join us at the David L. Lawrence Convention Center, located at 1000 Fort Duquesne Boulevard, Pittsburgh, PA, United States. This venue is renowned for its safety features and accessible location. Apart from the event, you can explore the nearby attractions that Pittsburgh has to offer. Parking will be available for your convenience. Don't forget to indulge in the flavors of India at the nearby Indian restaurants to make your evening even more enjoyable.
Secure Your Tickets Today!
We offer a variety of ticket options to suit every budget. General Adult Tickets are priced at $20.00. If you're planning to attend with a group, take advantage of our Adult Group of 10 and More tickets at just $18.00 per person. We're also thrilled to offer free entry for kids under 5. Don't miss out on this unique opportunity to experience a vibrant blend of cultures and traditions at the DHOL BAAJE 2026!
